versionTitles.ja: ホイール・オブ・ヘブン訳

subtitles.en: Curated selection from the Hekhalot literature — the 'Kabbalah' the Raëlian canon implicitly cites

descriptions.en: **Planned** Wheel of Heaven Translation of a curated selection from the Shi'ur Qomah / Hekhalot literature — the Hebrew esoteric corpus the Raëlian canon implicitly engages when it cites 'the Kabbalah' for the *parasangs*-measurement and 'height of the creator' passages (*The End of the World*, chapter *At the Root of All Religions*). Phase 5 priority. This translation closes one of the genuine source-tensions named in the *Reference corpus of the Raëlian canon* wiki entry. Source text and specific selection scope to be determined at translation start; not a complete book translation.
